'''Armin Weiss''' (or '''Weiß''' in German script) (5 November 1927 – 7 December 2010)<ref>[http://www.gruene-fraktion-bayern.de/cms/presse/dok/364/364369.sein_herzensthema_war_der_kampf_gegen_di.html gruene-faktion (German)] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20101229083626/http://www.gruene-fraktion-bayern.de/cms/presse/dok/364/364369.sein_herzensthema_war_der_kampf_gegen_di.html |date=2010-12-29 }}</ref> was a German [[inorganic chemist]] and politician of the [[Alliance '90/The Greens|Green Party]].

==Life==
Weiss was born and raised in Stefling (near [[Nittenau]]), not far from [[Wackersdorf]], where during the 1980s, the [[West German]] nuclear industry began building the [[nuclear reprocessing plant Wackersdorf]]. Upset by this move, Weiss took leave from his position as Professor of Inorganic Chemistry at [[LMU Munich]], and began making public appearances in opposition to the plant.  Eventually the construction of Wackersdorf was stopped. Later, as a member of the [[Bavarian state government]], he continued to oppose nuclear plants.  In 2007, Professor Weiss received the [[Nuclear-Free Future Award|Nuclear-Free Future Lifetime Achievement Award]].<ref>[http://www.nuclear-free.com/english/weiss.htm 2007 Nuclear-Free Future Lifetime Achievement Award] {{webarchive |url=https://web.archive.org/web/20071030175513/http://www.nuclear-free.com/english/weiss.htm |date=October 30, 2007 }}</ref><ref name="Ben">{{cite web
| url = http://www.uni-kiel.de/anorg/lagaly/group/klausSchiver/Weiss.pdf
| title = Armin Weiss on the occasion of his 75th birthday
| publisher = [[University of Kiel]]
| author = Klaus Beneke, Gerhard Lagaly}}</ref>

==Work==
The [[intercalation (chemistry)|intercalation]] in [[clay]] minerals was major research interest during the start of his academic career. [[Urea]] has been used as compound for the production of high quality [[porcelain|china]] for a long time but the mechanism of action was first described by Weiss in 1961.<ref name="Ben"/><ref>{{cite journal | doi = 10.1002/ange.19610732205 | title = Eine Schichteinschlußverbindung von Kaolinit mit Harnstoff | year = 1961 | last1 = Weiss | first1 = Armin | journal = Angewandte Chemie | volume = 73 | issue = 22 | pages = 736| bibcode = 1961AngCh..73..736W }}</ref><ref>{{cite journal | doi = 10.1002/ange.19630751604 | title = Ein Geheimnis des chinesischen Porzellans | year = 1963 | last1 = Weiss | first1 = Armin | journal = Angewandte Chemie | volume = 75 | issue = 16–17 | pages = 755–762| bibcode = 1963AngCh..75..755W }}</ref>
